name: ai.bondren/docs
title: Bondren Documentation
description: Search and read Bondren's public product documentation and API reference. No sign-in.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Read the canonical Markdown of one docs page by id, or a single section when an anchor is supplied. Returns the page/section URL, content hash, maturity, effective availability, and last-reviewed date alongside the markdown. Unknown page ids or anchors return a clean not-found error.

page_id.description: the docs page id (as returned by search_docs); required

anchor.description: optional heading anchor to read one section instead of the whole page

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the Bondren public docs corpus for ranked sections matching a query. Limit defaults to 5, and the ranked result set is the top 10 matching sections. Returns GA and preview results by default; planned content is excluded unless include_planned is true. Each item carries its canonical URL, content hash, maturity, effective availability, and last-reviewed date. Pass page_info.next_cursor as cursor; stop only when page_info.has_more is false.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-100).

query.description: the user's docs question or keywords; required

include_planned.description: include maturity=planned sections (excluded by default); optional
